cases.notes: A queued splat sidecar without an uploaded video must not block the editable scene or change scene version.
Uploading with a valid one-time token should create a queued splat job that deterministically progresses to ready across job polls.
A simulated failed splat job must leave the RoomPlan scene editable and must not increment scene version.
Video upload tokens are scene-scoped, one-time, and expire independently of editable scene state.
